steps.name: environment
steps.description: Persist NODE_ENV=development via /etc/profile.d and verify Node and npm exist and meet minimal versions. The profile snippet is conservative and performs runtime detection of npm global bin (using npm config get prefix) when a new shell starts; the install script itself does not run npm at profile write-time. The step validates Node (>=14.0.0) and npm (>=6.0.0) robustly by sanitizing version strings.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/simple_calculator_node.sh
# Write conservative profile that at runtime detects npm global prefix (no npm calls now)
sudo bash -c "cat > ${PROFILE_FILE} <<'PROFILE'
# SimpleCalculatorApplication global env
export NODE_ENV=development
# At shell runtime, if npm is available, prefer its global bin (if present)
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  npm_prefix=$(npm config get prefix 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$npm_prefix" ] && [ -d "$npm_prefix/bin" ]; then
    case ":$PATH:" in
      *":$npm_prefix/bin:") ;;
      *) export PATH="$npm_prefix/bin:$PATH" ;;
    esac
  fi
fi
PROFILE"
sudo chmod 0644 "$PROFILE_FILE"
# Validate runtime tools now
node_bin=$(command -v node || true)
npm_bin=$(command -v npm || true)
if [ -z "$node_bin" ] || [ -z "$npm_bin" ]; then
  echo "node or npm not found in PATH. node: ${node_bin:-MISSING}, npm: ${npm_bin:-MISSING}" >&2
  exit 2
fi
# Read versions and sanitize (remove prerelease/build + non-numeric suffixes)
raw_node_ver=$($node_bin -p "process.versions.node" 2>/dev/null || true)
raw_npm_ver=$($npm_bin -v 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "$raw_node_ver" ] || [ -z "$raw_npm_ver" ]; then
  echo "Unable to determine node/npm versions. node: ${raw_node_ver}, npm: ${raw_npm_ver}" >&2
  exit 3
fi
# Strip pre-release/build metadata (e.g., 18.18.0-rc -> 18.18.0)
sanitize_ver(){ echo "$1" | sed -E 's/[^0-9.].*$//' ; }
node_ver=$(sanitize_ver "$raw_node_ver")
npm_ver=$(sanitize_ver "$raw_npm_ver")
# numeric semver compare helper (major.minor.patch) -> padded integer
ver_parts(){ IFS=. read -r a b c <<< "$1" ; printf "%03d%03d%03d" "${a:-0}" "${b:-0}" "${c:-0}" ; }
if [ "$(ver_parts "$node_ver")" -lt "$(ver_parts "14.0.0")" ]; then
  echo "Node version $raw_node_ver (parsed $node_ver) is too old; require >=14.0.0" >&2
  exit 4
fi
if [ "$(ver_parts "$npm_ver")" -lt "$(ver_parts "6.0.0")" ]; then
  echo "npm version $raw_npm_ver (parsed $npm_ver) is too old; require >=6.0.0" >&2
  exit 5
fi
exit 0

steps.name: build and validate dev server (build/start/healthcheck/stop)
steps.description: Perform an explicit build (npm run build using local react-scripts) to satisfy BUILD requirement, then start the headless dev server using the local binary via the start.sh wrapper which sets HOST/PORT/BROWSER. Start in a new process group (setsid), capture PGID for robust cleanup, poll HTTP up to 120s and verify app marker in body to reduce false positives, collect evidence, remove temporary files, and ensure the entire process group is terminated on exit via trap.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WORKSPACE="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-calculator-40856-40905/SimpleCalculatorApplication"
cd "$WORKSPACE"
export NODE_ENV=development
HOST=127.0.0.1
PORT=3000
LOGFILE="$WORKSPACE/devserver.log"
EVIDENCE="$WORKSPACE/validation_evidence.txt"
TMP_RESP=$(mktemp /tmp/sc_resp.XXXX)
cleanup(){ rc=$?; rm -f "$TMP_RESP" 2>/dev/null || true; if [ -n "${PGID-}" ]; then kill -TERM -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 1; kill -KILL -"$PGID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; exit $rc; }
trap cleanup EXIT
# Build (production build) using local binary if available
if [ -x "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/react-scripts" ]; then
  NODE_ENV=development "$WORKSPACE/node_modules/.bin/react-scripts" build >"$WORKSPACE/build.log" 2>&1 || { echo "build failed; see $WORKSPACE/build.log" >&2; exit 10; }
else
  npm run build --silent --no-audit --no-fund >"$WORKSPACE/build.log" 2>&1 || { echo "build failed; see $WORKSPACE/build.log" >&2; exit 10; }
fi
# Start dev server via wrapper to ensure HOST/PORT/BROWSER are exported; run in new process group
HOST=$HOST PORT=$PORT BROWSER=none NODE_ENV=development setsid sh ./start.sh >"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 &
PID=$!
# capture process group id
sleep 0.2
PGID=$(ps -o pgid= "$PID" | tr -d ' ' || true)
# Wait up to 120s for health: HTTP 200 and body contains app marker text
SECS=0
OK=0
status=000
while [ $SECS -lt 120 ]; do
  if grep -q "Compiled successfully" "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null; then
    OK=1; break
  fi
  status=$(curl -sS --max-time 2 -o "$TMP_RESP" -w "%{http_code}" "http://127.0.0.1:${PORT}/" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ "$status" = "200" ]; then
    if grep -q "Simple Calculator App - dev server running" "$TMP_RESP" || grep -q '<div id="root">' "$TMP_RESP"; then
      OK=1; break
    fi
  fi
  sleep 1; SECS=$((SECS+1))
done
# collect evidence
{ echo "pid=$PID"; echo "pgid=${PGID:-}"; echo "http_status=$status"; echo "---- response head ----"; head -c 512 "$TMP_RESP" 2>/dev/null || true; echo "---- devserver log tail ----"; tail -n 200 "$LOGFILE" 2>/dev/null || true; } > "$EVIDENCE"
if [ "$OK" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo "healthcheck: OK" >> "$EVIDENCE"
  # cleanup will terminate PGID via trap
  true
else
  echo "healthcheck failed; see $EVIDENCE and $WORKSPACE/build.log" >&2
  cat "$EVIDENCE" >&2 || true
  exit 11
fi
# explicit successful exit (cleanup trap will run)
exit 0

change_logs.message: Refined from initial version: modified env-001, scaffold-001, deps-001, test-001, validation-001 to address analyst feedback. Changes: (env-001) write /etc/profile.d script without expanding $(npm bin -g) at write-time, make idempotent, source for current run and check Node/NPM versions; (scaffold-001) pin React/react-dom/react-scripts/jest to tested versions (React 18.2.0, react-scripts 5.0.1, jest 29.6.1), ensure index uses React 18 API to match pins; (deps-001) create package-lock deterministically via npm install --package-lock-only then npm ci; (test-001) run tests with CI=true to avoid watch prompts and prefer npx if available; (validation-001) set BROWSER=none and HOST=127.0.0.1, run server in its own process group (setsid) and kill process group on cleanup, extend wait to 120s and detect 'Compiled successfully' in logs in addition to HTTP checks. These changes resolve critical and high issues (heredoc PATH, pinned versions, deterministic lockfile, CI non-interactive tests, headless start & cleanup).

Refinements applied to address analyst HIGH recommendations: env-001 rewritten to avoid runtime npm invocations in /etc/profile.d, do not source profile for immediate effects, and use node to read normalized version; deps-001, test-001, and validation-001 now explicitly export NODE_ENV=development at runtime and invoke local binaries under ./node_modules/.bin instead of relying on npx --no-install; validation-001 switched from setsid+sudo PGID kills to nohup with PID capture + pkill -P for child cleanup and avoids sudo; removed reliance on build via npx --no-install as a hard check (treated optional) and improved evidence capture (HTTP status and response head). These changes fix PATH/ENV brittleness, version parsing, process lifecycle handling, and npx/local-bin assumptions. Modified steps: env-001, deps-001, test-001, validation-001; scaffold-001 adjusted start script to pin host/port to make headless start deterministic.

Refined plan to address analyst feedback: modified env-001 to detect npm global bin at runtime in profile and perform robust version checks (strip prerelease/build metadata and validate npm version); updated scaffold-001 to use 'react-scripts start' and add start.sh wrapper exporting HOST/PORT/BROWSER to ensure deterministic binding (addresses CLI flag misuse); updated deps-001 to document network requirement, prefer --prefer-offline when possible, and fail fast with clear messages; changed test-001 to run npm test (package.json) for consistency; enhanced validation-001 to perform an explicit npm run build using local react-scripts, start the dev server using the local binary via setsid to capture PGID, perform a stronger health check (HTTP 200 plus presence of app marker in body), remove temporary files, and terminate the entire process group on cleanup with trap. These changes address correctness, robustness, and housekeeping issues raised by the analyst (env-001, scaffold-001, deps-001, test-001, validation-001).
